name: Flying Pay
author: Rakib Hussain

sections.description:
Flying Pay is an all-in-one payment information gateway designed for Bangladeshi merchants. It provides a clean, modern interface for customers to get payment details and submit transaction information.

Key Features:

  • Mobile Banking: Support for bKash, Nagad, and Rocket.
  • Multi-Bank Support: Integrated with Al-Arafa Islami Bank, Pubali Bank, Dutch Bangla Bank, and Islami Bank PLC.
  • Crypto Support: Built-in Binance Pay and RedotPay options.
  • Interactive UI: Modern tab-based design with selection blur effects for better user experience.
  • Copy to Clipboard: One-click copy for Account numbers, Routing numbers, and Amounts.
  • File Upload: Option for customers to upload payment screenshots/slips for bank transfers.
  • Admin Control: Enable or disable any specific method from the WooCommerce settings.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the flying-pay-gateway folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  4. Click on Flying Pay to configure your bank accounts and mobile numbers.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support automatic payments?

No, Flying Pay is a manual payment gateway. It shows your payment details (Bank/Mobile/Crypto) to the customer, and they manually send the money and provide transaction info.

Can I use it without WooCommerce?

No, this plugin is specifically built as an extension for WooCommerce.

Which banks are supported?

Currently, it supports Al-Arafa Islami Bank (AIBL), Pubali Bank, Dutch Bangla Bank (DBBL), and Islami Bank (IBBL).

Is there a limit on how many payment methods I can enable?

No, you can enable or disable bKash, Nagad, Rocket, all 4 banks, and Crypto options simultaneously from the settings.

Does it support screenshot uploads?

Yes, customers can upload their payment slips or screenshots directly from the checkout page for bank transfers.
